description: This script manages database operations for a sports telecast platform, including migrations, resets, backups, and status checks. It interacts with a PostgreSQL database using command-line tools and handles tasks such as executing SQL files, tracking migrations, and resetting the database.

methods.name: print_status
methods.description: Outputs informational messages in green color.

methods.name: print_warning
methods.description: Outputs warning messages in yellow color.

methods.name: print_error
methods.description: Outputs error messages in red color.

methods.name: check_postgres
methods.description: Checks if PostgreSQL server is accessible.

methods.name: run_sql_file
methods.description: Executes a given SQL file against the database.

methods.name: create_migration_table
methods.description: Creates a table to track applied migrations.

methods.name: is_migration_executed
methods.description: Checks if a specific migration has already been run.

methods.name: record_migration
methods.description: Records the execution status of a migration.

methods.name: reset_database
methods.description: Drops all tables and types to reset the database (destructive).

methods.name: show_status
methods.description: Displays database status, including tables, migration history, and row counts.

methods.name: backup_database
methods.description: Creates a backup of the entire database.
